note: Two wooded camping areas in a pitch pine stand (a National Natural Landmark) around a small glacial lake, with a swimming beach, boat rentals and a footpath around the shore. Pets are not allowed anywhere in the park. --Claude
summary: Park page + 2026 policies + schedule + RA per-site read of all 193 units: 191 family sites, no hookups, dump/showers/store, 87 take 23 ft+ (max 38, all back-in), $35 ($40 lakeside W sites), season 5/8-10/24 (2026). Lakeview kept: the 13 W sites are tagged lakefront but sit in pine canopy ~55 m from the shore, and only 8W fits a rig. No pets in the park.
flags: Waterfront lakeview kept. RA tags 1W-13W 'Lakefront' (and prices them $40), but on Esri imagery they sit in continuous pine canopy ~50-60 m east of the shoreline (8W 43.83851,-71.21686 is ~57 m from the water); canopy makes it a view. Only 8W (35 ft) takes a 23-ft rig; the other W sites are 16-ft pop-up/tent or 10-ft tent pads.
Rig length: 87 of 193 RA units take 23 ft+; 83 are 16-ft pop-up/tent sites.
Pets: 'Pets are not allowed in the park' (camping policies and park page) - not in any structured field; put in the note.

Pin 43.8361,-71.2186 is at the day-use beach/pavilion between the two camping areas: the 100s area centres near 43.8330,-71.2195 (~350 m S) and the 200s/300s/W area near 43.8380,-71.2155 (~350 m NE); the nearest sites are ~250-300 m away. One pin cannot sit on both; if AWH wants it on sites, 43.8330,-71.2195 holds about half of them. Not a split (the areas are ~550 m apart on one entrance road).
